_doc: Image refs that are not in libs/images/sandbox-images.json (or a bench lock), each with a reason. Checked by scripts/images/check-image-refs.py; an entry or path that matches nothing fails the gate, so this list only shrinks.

thirdParty.docker.io/library/*: Docker Hub official images: upstream bases, test fixtures and SDK examples of plain registry refs
thirdParty.ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:*: upstream uv image, copied into the docs MCP server image
thirdParty.ghcr.io/shopify/toxiproxy:*: upstream Toxiproxy, the latency and bandwidth shaper of the Cua Volume benchmark (libs/cua/crates/cua-volume/bench)
thirdParty.ghcr.io/cirruslabs/*: upstream Tart base images (legacy Tart adapter in cua-sandbox)
thirdParty.winarenamlacr.azurecr.io/*: Windows Agent Arena's upstream Azure registry (winarena adapter docs)
thirdParty.ghcr.io/me/*: placeholder namespace in tests and examples (a user's own image)
thirdParty.ghcr.io/acme/*: placeholder namespace in docs and tests (a user's own image)
thirdParty.ghcr.io/org/*: placeholder namespace in CLI help and docs
thirdParty.ghcr.io/my-org/*: placeholder namespace in lume CLI help
thirdParty.123456789012.dkr.ecr.*: placeholder AWS account in docs and tests (private ECR)
thirdParty.ghcr.io/acme-corp/*: fictional private registry ref in the cua-telemetry privacy test (proves image refs are redacted)
